integrity: The proof exhausts the possible independent complements of a crown graph. A one-side complement forces the opposite side plus at least two selected vertices; a complement meeting both sides is exactly one deleted matching pair. Comparing these two cardinalities yields the value and every minimum set.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats balanced crown graphs, not arbitrary matching deletions from complete bipartite graphs.
The n=3 scalar value is already covered by the known cycle formula.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=8 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown-graph treatment may exist.
title: Minimum double outer-independent dominating sets of crown graphs
